subject.title: feat: generic session discussion seam with Control UI panel

question: Should OpenClaw standardize session discussion as one replaceable process-wide plugin provider, or require a scoped/multi-provider contract before exposing this SDK and gateway API?
rationale: The patch is an additive public API, but neither current repository context nor the supplied evidence establishes the permanent ownership and coexistence model for multiple discussion-capable plugins.

options.title: Approve the single-provider contract
options.body: Accept one process-wide provider, including replacement-on-registration semantics, as the supported initial plugin model.

options.title: Require a scoped provider model
options.body: Pause merge until the API can select providers deterministically by plugin, session, or advertised capability rather than registration order.

recommendation.title: Approve the single-provider contract
recommendation.body: Accept one process-wide provider, including replacement-on-registration semantics, as the supported initial plugin model.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed seam and are the only concrete feature-history owner available in the supplied review context.
